evals.prompt: Draft one X post from a supplied public release note.

expectations.text: Returns a draft that fits the standard 280-character limit and reports its count.
Uses only facts established by the supplied release note.
Does not post or schedule it.

evals.prompt: Write a 2000-character X post without stating the account's plan or current composer limit.

expectations.text: Does not assume access to a longer-post entitlement.
Tightens the idea or asks for verified account capability.
Does not silently convert the request into a thread.

evals.prompt: Claim that everyone is adopting a tool based on three posts from today.

expectations.text: Rejects the unsupported consensus claim or qualifies the small sample.
Requests an adequate source packet for the trend assertion.
Keeps private or employer context out of the draft.

evals.prompt: Write a standalone public progress post about a supplied [SUBJECT] change, its user-visible effect, and a supplied [PUBLIC_LINK], while a parent URL is also present in the request.

expectations.text: Recognizes that the supplied parent URL makes this a reply task and routes to okhp3-twitter-comment instead of silently drafting a standalone post.
Preserves the supplied distinction between a shipped runtime fix and repository-only supporting artifacts.
Does not post, schedule, or create a thread while routing the request.

evals.prompt: Draft a standalone X post saying a participant has received an official program's final outcome, but supply only an older announcement and no result.

expectations.text: Does not state the unverified win as fact and offers an aspirational or evidence-requesting alternative.
Marks current result, deadline, or scoring claims unknown when the supplied source is stale or insufficient.
Returns confirmed, aspirational, and unknown status for consequential claims.
Returns a draft without publication or silent thread expansion.
